_provenance.citation: Wu et al., LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory, ICLR 2025

nevertwice.setup: local bge-m3 via Ollama (calibrated fusion; 0 deps, no server, no DB)
nevertwice.label: Nevertwice (calibrated fusion, the shipped ranker)

mem0.search: dense cosine + fastembed BM25 (Mem0 default hybrid); entity boost off
mem0.setup: pip install mem0ai ollama fastembed; embedded qdrant (no server)
mem0.label: Mem0 store search (infer=False: no LLM extraction, one memory per item; its default hybrid of dense cosine + fastembed BM25 when fastembed is installed)

langmem.mode: store search only: LangGraph InMemoryStore, no memory manager, no LLM
langmem.setup: pip install langgraph langmem langchain-ollama (no server)
langmem.label: LangGraph InMemoryStore semantic search (LangMem's store layer, no memory manager)

amem.mode: store search only: chromadb cosine, no LLM note construction, no link evolution
amem.setup: pip install chromadb (A-MEM's vector store) + Ollama embeddings
amem.label: chromadb cosine over the same vectors (A-MEM's vector store, no LLM notes, no links)
